prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production sprite-parts atlas for a custom Plants vs. Zombies (2009 PC) mushroom plant called Chill-shroom.
Input images: Image 1 is the current IN-GAME result whose flat/simple silhouette needs replacement; DO NOT copy its flat illustration. Images 2–5 are authentic original Sun-shroom/Puff-shroom/Fume-shroom parts, STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their hand-painted cartoon volume, chunky organic outlines, simple expressive eyes, broad warm highlights and deep colored shadows. This is new plant artwork, not a challenge card illustration.
Output: a genuinely TRANSPARENT 1536×1024 atlas laid out as a precise 3-column by 2-row invisible grid of six 512×512 cells. NO grid lines, labels, lettering, backdrop, floor, effects, or extra objects. Each part fully isolated with clear transparent margins. Do not render a complete assembled character anywhere.
Top-left cell: isolated plump mushroom CAP ONLY. Width:height approximately 1.7:1, a slightly lopsided domed rounded cap, not a flat umbrella. Dusty blue-teal midtones, broad soft upper-left pale cyan highlight, curved deep desaturated indigo underside, subtle thick drooping rim. Three to five irregular pale frosty spots wrapping the rounded surface; no tiny decorative snowflake emblems. Thick but varied dark blue-brown outline with warm painterly edge softness. A tiny glimpse of underside at the lower rim adds depth. No face, no stem, no spikes, no muzzle, no crystal crown. Cap centered about (256,256) inside its cell, approximately 420 wide by 245 high.
Top-middle cell: isolated STEM/BODY ONLY, NO FACE OR EYES. Short, squat, soft pear shape, gently rounded shoulders tapering into a plump wider belly. Creamy ivory on upper-left/front, warm pale ochre low midtone and mint/teal right shade; deep teal cast shadow across the top just beneath a mushroom cap. Rounded bottom. Variable dark brown/green outline, softly painted gradients, a few broad volume strokes. No long straight column, no lamp pedestal, no limbs, no mouth. About 260 wide by 230 high, centered in cell.
Top-right cell: isolated tucked root/base ONLY, a single very low rounded organic mint-cream cushion with two tiny natural root lobes, like the foot of a mushroom. Subtle dark contact shading, broad creamy front highlight. About 300 wide by 65 high. No hard pedestal or separate shoes.
Bottom-left cell: isolated pair of OPEN EYES only on transparency. Simple original-game dark oval eyes, a mildly asymmetrical curious/wary expression, small ivory highlight on upper-left of each eye. No eyebrows, face skin, mouth or cap. Pair about 230 wide by 90 high, eyes separated by a large clear gap. Large simple readable dark ovals, not realistic irises or anime eyes.
Bottom-middle cell: isolated SAME pair of eyes HALF CLOSED, same pair width and eye center positions as bottom-left, heavier gently lowered upper eyelids, dark oval lower halves. No skin or other artwork.
Bottom-right cell: isolated SAME eyes FULLY CLOSED, two short expressive curved dark eyelid strokes at exactly corresponding eye centers, same spacing as bottom-left. No skin or other artwork.
Art direction: this must look like a polished native 2009 PvZ sprite, with the original reference images' depth, weight, irregularity and graphic clarity at 80 pixels tall. A restrained hand-painted cartoon sprite, not vector clipart, not a modern glossy 3D render, not pixel art, not a children's sticker. Avoid flat fill, perfect symmetry, thin uniform outlines, ornamental surface detail, glass shine, electric glow, duplicated Ice-shroom or Puff-shroom anatomy. Truly transparent background with preserved antialiasing, no checkerboard baked into pixels.
